about.title: About Payroll Tax Calculator - Employee Tax Withholding Tool
about.description: The Payroll Tax Calculator is a comprehensive payroll management tool designed to help employers and employees calculate accurate federal and state tax withholdings from paychecks. This calculator computes federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, state taxes, and other deductions to determine net take-home pay. Whether you're processing payroll or planning your budget, this tool provides precise tax calculations for all pay frequencies.

faq.q: How accurate are payroll tax calculations?
faq.a: Our calculator uses current federal and state tax tables, but actual withholdings may vary based on employer payroll systems, rounding methods, and specific deduction timing. Results provide close estimates for planning purposes.

faq.q: What's the difference between gross and net pay?
faq.a: Gross pay is your total earnings before any deductions. Net pay is your take-home amount after federal taxes, state taxes, Social Security, Medicare, and other deductions are subtracted from gross pay.

faq.q: How do pre-tax deductions affect my taxes?
faq.a: Pre-tax deductions like 401k contributions, health insurance, and FSA reduce your taxable income, lowering federal and state income taxes. However, they don't reduce Social Security and Medicare taxes.

faq.q: Why might my actual paycheck differ from the calculator?
faq.a: Differences can occur due to employer-specific deductions, different rounding methods, timing of deduction changes, supplemental income tax rates, or state-specific rules not captured in general calculations.
